name: running_bowline
title: Running bowline
about: A noose that runs freely and never jams: a bowline tied round its own standing part, so the standing part passes through the loop. Shown loose and flat.

steps.caption: Bring the rope round and make a small loop in it: the cord crosses over the part it came from.
Take the end round the standing part further back along the rope: over it, round, and back under it. The standing part now runs through the big loop.
Bring the end up through the small loop from underneath.
Pass it behind the part above the small loop.
And back down through the small loop, beside itself: a bowline. Pull the standing part and the loop runs down it like a noose.
